name: Masc, Mask & Masked!
summary: It's time to retrieve the mask of the great Niarlatopepe. Search and find clues among human apps and mundane conversations. But beware! There's something more dangerous than cosmic horrors: human—and inhuman—relationships! You'd better dress to impress and hurry so you don't keep your date waiting too long. Your fortune depends on your small decisions, little one. Will you let yourself be led astray by the ghosts of the past, present, or future, or will you forge your own path?
